This game is a great mix between resource management and tactical battles. As the game admits, it has a high level of difficulty, but that adds to the appeal of the game. Overall, Battle Brothers is a gritty game where losing people is a reality. The first time I played the game, I did not make it very far. I lost the entire company on my first contract. The second time, I started to get the hang of the battles, but I overestimated my company's strength when I took on a "two-star" contract..then lost everyone. Each time you lose your entire company, you learn a little more. In this way it feels similar to a rogue-lite, but you are getting better as a player instead of characters getting stronger.

The resource management is also fun. There is a bit of judging the market on whether you should buy furs or lumber from one town to sell to another. Balancing the economics with ensuring your company is properly sized and equipped adds an element to the game which is not very common in the genre.

Battle Brothers is the first game that I have played in a long time that I have wanted to stay up late playing because it is drives you to want to do "one more thing" before you quit for the night.

Nechal sem se zlákat a pořádně sem si nic nezjistil, velká chyba. Očekával sem, že to bude obtížnější, tak sem začal logicky na nízké obtížnosti s výcvikem, ekonomika všechno lehké. Po 6 hodinách se točím v kruzích, nemůžu vydělat dost peněz abych si pořídil lepší zbraň nebo zbroj, ekonomika nefunguje, protože jediný způsob jak něco prodat se ziskem je cestovat přes celý svět, takže se dostanete +- na nulu, protože než na to místo dorazíte, tak vás stáhne žold, zásoby a přinejhorším ještě nějaké přepadení a když něco porazíte tak zisk je tak nízký, že většinou nepokryje ani náklady na cestu do nejbližšího města, protože žold se vyplácí denně. Když ta hra nefunguje na nejnižší obtížnost, jak to má člověk potom hrát na normální nebo těžkou obtížnost... úplný nesmysl.
Prakticky to vypadá asi tak, že dostanete ve městě kontrakt na zabití banditů s odměnou třeba 300, trvá vám den je vystopovat, pak je porazíte, dostanete hovno a přitom si ještě poničíte zbroj v horším případě vám nějaký člen umře, protože RNG takže půlku boje se nemůžete trefit. Pak vyhrajte jdete zpátky do města. Jenže... musíte koupit materiál na opravu vybavení, ideálně najmout nového rekruta, zásoby a ve výsledku jste ještě v mínusu. Silnější rekruty si nemůžete dovolit, takže naverbujete nějaké otrhance protože samotný tutoriál vás vybízí k tomu mít více jednotek, jenže zase platíte větší žold a ten se platí denně, takže než něco uděláte tak jste zase na nule a takhle pořád dokola. Jenže jak se takhle točíte v kruzích tak nepřátelé začnou být těžší. Hra vám řekne tady je lehký úkol, stačí zabít dvě monstra v lese, takže jdete už máte i trochu zkušenější žoldáky, ale co to? Monstra se léčí vy je nemůžete trefit, takže ikdyž hrajou jednou za pár kol tak vás prostě vyjebou... a to má být lehký úkol.

Jako tohle je přesně ten typ hry kdy je standartní postup začít novou hru, zjistíte aha něco je takhle a pak začít zase novou hru, protože jak uděláte chybu tak se z toho asi už nevzpamatujete.
Navíc ani nemáte skoro žádné možnosti? Jako čekal sem že hra co jede na bázi 2d prostě obrázků téměř bude mít tunu mechanik... tady? Nemůžete prozkoumávat ruiny, nemůžete útočit na karavany, obchod skoro neexistující, nic prostě nic, další hra co se vymlouvá na sandbox, aby nemusela ve hře mít nic s výmluvou na "je to sandbox, můžete dělat co chcete" ale nemůžete.

Battle Brothers is once of the best games I have ever played. I always find myself coming back and playing for hours on end, enjoying every part of the game's progression, the story you build for yourself and the complete freedom you have around the game.

To start, this is game is the epitome of Sandbox. You spawn in and then you're given freedom to do whatever you want to do that the game offers. This mainly begins with contracts, recruiting more 'brothers' and building your mercenary company but can also mean you want to explore and chase loot in ruins, fight in the arenas, operate as a trading company or raid and pillage those caravans for the goods!

The game was clearly made with love for sandbox and difficulty, with a truly brutal turn-based combat system that rewards good builds and battle tactics, and punishes stupidity like no other game. Battle Brothers is a hard game, no doubt but once you win battles flawlessly, the sense of accomplishment is second to none. You will have hardships and losses with your victories, but in the end, the point is not about beating the game but the story that is told of your company. Which leads into my next point: The Brothers of Battle Brothers.

Each character you recruit is unique, with skills, stats and traits that make them unique, but also with excellent backstories that are extremely varied; You don't just have one backstory for the butcher, but many, and they change how you might view them, as well as the traits they begin with. Each background and traits might change your mind on someone who has reasonably good stats, or on the other hand you might take the risk of conflicting backgrounds if the stats are too good to pass up - Beware the double Hedge Knight idea, they are not friends.
The game also makes you not only root for your company but individual brothers themselves, and you'll have your favourites and your fodder to save your favourites from certain death, because death is a very pivotal part of this game. 
You will get attached to brothers who in one moment, are thriving, and the next, are dead on the ground, permanently. But you will also see those brothers you once expected to keep around become heroes who build the story of -your- game, as once again, there is no main story, only what you do and what adds to the replay ability of this game to become endless. 

I think this is the main reason why Battle Brothers moves beyond the average game that does perma-death, sandbox adventure, is that the origins you can play, the uniqueness of theme and no handholding / intro quests adds to the part that you are in a living, breathing world that goes on without you. Each playthrough is a story, most that will end in your death or need to retire, but some might go on with great victory. 

For me, this game is a 9/10, and made a 10/10 with the Legends Mod, which I highly recommend you get after one playthrough of the base game. The DLC are excellent and none of them are a waste of money or not needed, as they add alot to the game and build on the initial vanilla, not invalidating it or overhauling it. Legends Mod goes a step further and adds alot more, but can be a difficulty spike for newer players. 

This game is for you if you like:
- Medieval Fantasy games with a darker feel
- Harder, turn-based fighting reliant on strategy and tactics
- Sandbox games where you make your story
- A guarantee of replayability
- A mix of dark horror writing and humour that spices the game up

Lastly, if you pick up the game, take all the time you can with it. Read the background stories, read the pop-ups and take in the world you are in. And remember, losing is fun.

Battle Brothers — это одна из самых глубоких и хардкорных тактических RPG, в которые я играл. Ты управляешь отрядом наёмников в жестоком средневековом мире, где каждая ошибка может стоить жизни бойцу, которого ты развивал десятки часов.
У игры уникальная система боёв: пошаговая тактика, где важны позиция, усталость, мораль, высота местности, броня и оружие. Здесь нет «избранного героя» — любой наёмник может погибнуть от случайного удара арбалета или топора.
Очень нравятся события и диалоги между бойцами. Во время путешествий происходят разные случайные истории, конфликты, встречи и выборы, которые могут повлиять на отряд, отношения между наёмниками и дальнейшее развитие компании.
Отдельно стоит отметить систему травм. После тяжёлых ранений персонажи могут получить постоянные увечья: потерять глаз, заработать повреждение мозга, сломанные кости и другие последствия, которые реально влияют на характеристики. Из-за этого каждый боец становится уникальным.
Игра невероятно хардкорная: здесь не прощают ошибок, а победы ощущаются по-настоящему заслуженными. Особенно с модом Legends, который добавляет ещё больше контента, механик, событий и вариантов развития отряда.
Честно говоря, сначала я играл в пиратскую версию, потому что хотел просто попробовать игру. Но после того как разобрался в механиках и провёл в ней много часов, понял, почему у Battle Brothers такая преданная аудитория. Это настоящий бриллиант для любителей сложных тактических игр.

재밌게 즐겼지만 좀 아쉬웠던 부분을 추려보자면

1. 심심한 전투 - 전투모션이 캐릭터가 움찔움찔거리기만 함. 보자마자 이게 뭐야? 라는 소리가 나옴. 입문자들은 적응하는데 시간좀 걸림

2. 다회차 불가능 - 1회차만 해도 체력소모 극심. 기원은 많은데 체력이슈로 연속 플레이 힘듬

3. 반복성노가다 - 결국엔 던전파밍, 유니크 노가다 무한반복. 이 게임의 최종 컨텐츠이자 게임에 질려버리게 만드는 원흉

4. 단조로운 전투방식 - 맵의 지형을 활용하는 요소나 기여도가 적음. 용병 피지컬이나 템빨이 승패 기여도의 90%.  갠적으로 뒤판정, 옆판정 둬서 크리뎀이나 데미지증가 요소를 넣었으면 어땠을까 하는 아쉬움도 있음 

5. 활궁수의 존재여부 - 활이 너무 쓰레기임. 키울 이유가 1도 없는 직업. 펜서같은 뽕맛도 없고 보스 저격도 불가능(보스들 보통 지형이나 호위해주는 적몹때문) 갠적으로 명중률 보정 시스템이 원거리한테만 가혹하다고 생각함. 활은 그냥 없다 생각하고 해야됨 (원거리는 투척만 키우는걸로)

그외 투기장이나 무역은 좀 애매하다 생각들고 장점도 적으면 엄청 많음. 왕좌의게임류 좋아하면 세계관 비슷해서 몰입 잘되고 과하지 않은 색채톤이나 브금도 게임에 편안하게 몰입하기 좋음. 특히 이겜은  유니크 먹는 뽕맛이 엄청남. dlc는 무조건 사는걸로 권장

I found sometimes I just kept save scumming because I felt the game was just being unfair. Quite often I would have one of my best men (level 11) just get two shot from some crazy lucky hits. Perhaps I could be more strategically minded, but there are times where I made accidental clicks or mistakes and the entire fight is over, one critical misclick. You can also get insanely lucky but at the same time it sort of takes away from the win if you're just rolling the dice over and over. Get unlucky? Well have fun quitting to menu to actually load your save (was this intentional?) and try again because the rng blasts you.

Composition plays a big part as it should but almost too big of a part, if you're slightly countered in later fights you just have to save scum or avoid taking the quest or fight. Not a huge fan of feeling artificially gated because I don't spend another week training up alts to present a better party. 

But I think that's just the theme of the game, you're supposed to at some point except tough defeats, I just don't care enough to grind that out, takes too long and gets too frustrating. Not a huge fan of the progression.
